overall_goal: Gather and measure the oil, ghee, spices, and cashews needed for sauteing

goals.description: Retrieve spoons from the cutlery drawer
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer, selects multiple spoons, stacks them, and places them on the chopping board for later use.
The person fetches the bottle of olive oil from the cabinet and the packet of ghee from the refrigerator, placing them on the chopping board.

goals.description: Prepare the weighing scale and measure bay leaves
goals.rationale: The person sets up the electronic weighing scale and spice containers, then opens the bag of bay leaves to extract and place them on the measuring plate.

goals.description: Measure out cinnamon sticks and cloves
goals.rationale: The person opens the respective bags for cinnamon sticks and cloves, taking out the required amounts and adding them to the spice plate.

goals.description: Measure out anise flower and cardamom
goals.rationale: The person retrieves anise flowers and cardamoms from their bags, places them on the plate, and seals the bags.
The person sorts through the plastic bags to find the cashews, opens the bag, breaks a cashew in half, and places the nuts on the masala plate.
